journal_entries.description: Commencement - recognize ROU asset and lease liability
First annual lease payment (annuity due - all principal)
Final annual lease payment - extinguishes lease liability
Final straight-line amortization of ROU asset

notes: (a) Finance lease: lease term 4 yrs = 100% of the 4-yr economic life (>=75%) and PV of payments = 100% of the $320,000 fair value (>=90%); discount at the 5% implicit rate because it is known to Northwind, so the 5.5% IBR is not used. (b) PV of the four annuity-due payments at 5% computes to $319999.99; the stated payment is exactly the cent-rounded annuity-due payment for a $320000.00 present value, and the $0.01 gap is inside the $0.02 band that quoting the payment to a cent can create, so the liability is measured at $320000.00 (= fair value, consistent with the 4-year full-payout structure). (c) Year 4 accrues no interest - the 1/1/Year 4 payment retires the liability. Mechanical 5% x $81853.79 gives $4092.69 of Year 3 interest; the schedule shows $4092.67 so the Interest column foots to total interest of $23785.84 ($343785.84 cash paid less $320000.00 recognized) and the final payment clears the liability to exactly $0 as part (f) requires - a $0.02 last-period rounding plug. (d)/(f) ROU amortized straight-line over the 4-year lease term ($80000.00/yr) because ownership does not transfer and there is no purchase option. (e) Current portion = the 1/1/Year 2 payment, which is entirely principal since no interest accrues between 12/31 and the next-day payment.
